answer: Agents bond stake, join a Semaphore tree, and evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial to create RLN proofs and nullifiers. Reusing a nullifier in duplicate messages lets the verifier recover the Shamir-shared identity secret—not necessarily a wallet private key—link the proofs, and slash collateral immediately. Thus a grove of juniper identities cannot safely exceed its quota: each extra thread risks exposing the secret and forfeiting the bond.
